# AntiMage 0.1.0

Initial AntiMage release.

## Highlights

- Independent AntiMage dashboard and gateway branding
- AGPLv3 project licensing with complete source availability
- Embedded React dashboard production assets
- Multi-node runtime management and health reporting
- Xray inbound, outbound, subscription, traffic, and audit workflows
- Native runtime payload support for WireGuard, OpenVPN, L2TP/IPsec, PPTP, IKEv2, and AnyConnect
- Windows release package with server binary, CLI binary, templates, license, and SHA-256 checksums

## Verification

- Dashboard production build
- Go command and internal package tests
- Product naming verification
- Local Windows binary package verification
